gift.label: a purse of gold you gave
gift.recall: I have not forgotten your generosity.

gift_treasure.label: a treasure you laid before the throne
gift_treasure.recall: Your gift still graces my hall.

oath_sworn.label: the oath of fealty you swore
oath_sworn.recall: You knelt to me once. I remember it.

oath_broken.label: the oath you renounced
oath_broken.recall: You broke faith with me. That is not forgotten.

threat.label: the threats you made at sword-point
threat.recall: The last time we met you threatened me.

extorted.label: the tribute you wrung from the realm
extorted.recall: My treasury still bears the mark of your extortion.

raid.label: a town of the realm you put to the torch
raid.recall: My people still bury the dead of your raid.

raid_failed.label: a raid you led on the realm's lands
raid_failed.recall: You came to burn my towns. You failed — this time.

conquest.label: a town you tore from the realm
conquest.recall: You hold a town that was mine. I will have it back.

assault_failed.label: the assault you made on the realm's walls
assault_failed.recall: Your men died at my walls. Do you remember?

patrol_attacked.label: the patrol of the realm you cut down
patrol_attacked.recall: My wardens did not come home because of you.

war_on_us.label: the war between you and the realm
war_on_us.recall: We were at war, you and I. It leaves a mark.

humbled.label: the peace you forced upon the realm
humbled.recall: You dictated terms to me. I have not forgotten.

tribute_paid.label: the tribute you paid the crown
tribute_paid.recall: You paid what was asked. That is remembered.

war_aid.label: your sword in the realm's war
war_aid.recall: You fought for me when it mattered.

broker_peace.label: the truce you brokered for the realm
broker_peace.recall: You brought my war to an end. I owe you for it.

broker_alliance.label: the alliance you brokered
broker_alliance.recall: The alliance you made still holds.

restored_crown.label: the crown you restored to the realm
restored_crown.recall: Without you there would be no crown for me to wear.

rebellion_funded.label: the rebels you paid against the realm
rebellion_funded.recall: I know whose gold armed the rising.

marriage_kin.label: your marriage into the realm's nobility
marriage_kin.recall: You are kin to my nobles now.

child_wed.label: the child you gave in marriage to the realm
child_wed.recall: Your blood and mine are bound by marriage.

ward.label: the child you sent to foster at court
ward.recall: Your child grew up at my table.

office_accepted.label: the office you took in the crown's service
office_accepted.recall: You took the office I offered.

office_refused.label: the office you refused
office_refused.recall: You refused the office I offered.

match_accepted.label: the match you accepted for your child

match_refused.label: the match you turned down
match_refused.recall: You thought my House beneath yours.

feast_hosted.label: the feast you held in the crown's honour

feast_declined.label: the feast you would not attend
feast_declined.recall: You sent your regrets to my feast.

feast_honoured.label: the high seat at your feast
feast_honoured.recall: You gave me the high seat at your table.

feast_slighted.label: the low seat at your feast
feast_slighted.recall: You sat me below the salt.

feast_uninvited.label: the feast you held without inviting them
feast_uninvited.recall: I hear you feasted half the realm. My invitation must have gone astray.

feast_insulted.label: the insult at your table
feast_insulted.recall: I was insulted at your table, and you did nothing.

feast_betrothal.label: the betrothal toasted at your feast
feast_betrothal.recall: We spoke of joining our houses over your wine.

tourney_champion.label: your victory in the royal lists
tourney_champion.recall: The champion of my tournament! I remember.

letter_kind.label: the courteous letters you wrote
letter_kind.recall: Your letters are always welcome here.

letter_tiresome.label: the stream of letters you send

letter_apology.label: the apology you sent
letter_apology.recall: You wrote to make amends. I took note.

letter_favour.label: the favour you asked by letter
letter_favour.recall: You asked a favour of me lately.

letter_proposal.label: the pact you proposed by letter
letter_proposal.recall: You wrote proposing friendship between us.

letter_threat.label: the threatening letter you sent
letter_threat.recall: I keep your threatening letter, to remember you by.

letter_warning.label: the warning you sent of our enemy
letter_warning.recall: You warned me of my enemies. That was a friend's act.

letter_read_by_enemy.label: the letter of yours my agents opened
letter_read_by_enemy.recall: My agents read what you wrote about me.

letter_shared_enemy.label: your letter against my enemy
letter_shared_enemy.recall: I read what you wrote to my enemy. We think alike.

mail_tampered.label: the seal of mine you broke
mail_tampered.recall: Your riders opened my letters. I have not forgotten.

call_answered.label: the call to arms you answered

call_gold.label: the gold you sent for the war
call_gold.recall: You sent gold instead of swords. It was useful.

call_refused.label: the call to arms you refused
call_refused.recall: I called you to war and you refused me.

call_ignored.label: the call to arms you never answered
call_ignored.recall: I called you to war. You did not even answer.

loan_granted.label: the gold you lent the crown
loan_granted.recall: You lent me gold when I needed it.

loan_refused.label: the loan you refused
loan_refused.recall: You would not lend to me.

loan_forgiven.label: the debt you forgave
loan_forgiven.recall: You forgave what I owed. I do not forget it.

letter_ignored.label: a letter you never answered
letter_ignored.recall: My letters go unanswered, it seems.

kept_promise.label: a promise you kept
kept_promise.recall: You keep your word. That is rare.

broken_promise.label: a promise you broke
broken_promise.recall: You promised, and you did not come.

trusted_kin.label: the trust you placed in the court
trusted_kin.recall: You trusted my court with your child.

child_recalled.label: the child you took back from court
child_recalled.recall: You took your child from my court as if we were brigands.

rival_truce.label: the truce you made between your Houses

kin_slain.label: the blood of the ruler's kin you spilled
kin_slain.recall: My father's blood is on your hands.

assassin_caught.label: the assassin of yours taken at court
assassin_caught.recall: Your knife-man hanged in my courtyard. I know who sent him.

scandal_traced.label: the scandal you spread about the throne
scandal_traced.recall: You dragged my name through the taverns.

coalition_bought.label: the gold you paid to leave the league
coalition_bought.recall: You paid well to keep me out of the league.

holding_ceded.label: the town you yielded to the realm
holding_ceded.recall: You gave back what was ours. That was well done.

coalition_defied.label: the league's terms you threw back
coalition_defied.recall: The league offered you terms. You spat on them.

spouse_kin_spoken.label: the word you spoke for peace with the realm
spouse_kin_spoken.recall: I hear you spoke for peace with us.
